movelist.name: Powder Snow
movelist.effect: Powder Snow Freezes all Legal Targets on 19+.

movelist.name: Charge
movelist.effect: If the user performs an Electric Move on their next turn that deals damage, add its Damage Dice Roll an extra time to the damage. Raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Echoed Voice
movelist.effect: If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainer in the Encounter on the previous round, increase its Damage Base by +4. If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainers during both the previous two rounds, increase its Damage Base by +8.

movelist.name: Thunder Shock
movelist.effect: Thunder Shock Paralyzes the target on 17+.

abilities.name: Klutz
abilities.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

abilities.name: Slush Rush
abilities.effect: While in Hailing Weather or under half maximum Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.
